searchLog: Read life/PIPELINE.md first and excluded everything already applied-to or rejected (Stripe x2, IBM x6, Tesla, Figma, McMaster-Carr, Simon-Kucher, IMC, Enova, Point72/Cubist, Graviton, Robinhood, Mathematica, Veeva, Claude Corps, Capital One, CarMax, Micron, Kalshi, Robert Half, Retell AI FDE, Ford, Red Ventures, TikTok, Goldman Sachs, McKinsey, Notion BDR, Disney, Horizon Fellowship, LSEG, MATS, Anthropic Fellows, Northslope, Last Mile, Yale SOM — ~35 rows). Also resolved the graduation-date note the task prompt flagged: life/PROFILE.md shows Dom settled this himself 2026-08-04 to December 2026, matching morning-briefing/profile.md — no live conflict, both agree. This is the second run in a row (also 2026-10-27) where WebFetch cannot resolve almost any target-company domain: confirmed ENOTFOUND this run on www.databricks.com, www.nvidia.com, www.google.com, openai.com, sierra.ai, job-boards.greenhouse.io, boards.greenhouse.io, jobs.ashbyhq.com, and api.ashbyhq.com (tested both the Scale AI and OpenAI Ashby boards) — every target-company career/ATS domain attempted failed to resolve. Only anthropic.com and github.com resolved; checked __agentproxy/status, which shows no relay failures for these hosts, so this is the session's network allowlist, not a transient outage. Anthropic's own careers index loaded (job-boards.greenhouse.io individual listing pages, where YOE/eligibility actually live, do not) and shows only mid/senior Applied AI Architect and Forward Deployed Engineer reqs (several Staff-level, all international except SF/NYC/Seattle) with no new-grad track, consistent with target-companies.json's note — nothing eligible to surface even from the one domain that worked. WebSearch (a separate, unaffected path) surfaced real-looking leads — Databricks 'Associate Product Manager, New Grad (2027 Start)' (P-1336, SF/Mountain View/Bellevue, Fall 2026 or Spring 2027 grads per aggregator text) — but per hunt.md's verification rule, a search snippet or third-party aggregator (simplify.jobs, seedtable, etc.) is not sufficient; the actual databricks.com page must load to confirm it's open now and unmodified, and it does not load this run. Declining to include it, or anything else found only via search, on snippet strength alone. Zero verified opportunities this run — not because nothing fits, but because the environment cannot reach the pages needed to verify. This needs a fix to the session's network policy (allow the job-board/ATS domains: greenhouse.io, ashbyhq.com, and individual company career domains) before the hunt can do its job again.
